Saleor PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated password for the private Saleor database.

Saleor API.ADMIN_EMAIL: Email address for the administrator created on the first boot.
Saleor API.ADMIN_PASSWORD: Generated first-boot administrator password; changing it later does not rotate the account.
Saleor API.SECRET_KEY: Generated Django signing secret shared with the worker.
Saleor API.EMAIL_URL: Optional dj-email-url SMTP connection string for transactional email.
Saleor API.AWS_MEDIA_BUCKET_NAME: Railway Bucket name used for durable Saleor media.
Saleor API.AWS_MEDIA_PRIVATE_BUCKET_NAME: Railway Bucket name used for protected Saleor files.

Saleor Worker.ADMIN_EMAIL: Must match the API administrator email.
Saleor Worker.ADMIN_PASSWORD: Must match the API first-boot administrator password.
Saleor Worker.SECRET_KEY: Must match the API Django signing secret.
Saleor Worker.EMAIL_URL: Optional dj-email-url SMTP connection string shared with the API.

Saleor Dashboard.PORT: Internal HTTP port used by Railway health checks and routing.
Saleor Dashboard.API_URL: Public Saleor GraphQL endpoint injected into the Dashboard at startup.
